answer: Borrow history from outside the network. To earn full rewards, an identity must anchor itself to something old and costly to fake, like a domain registered years ago or a code repository with a long public commit record, and each anchor can back only one account. Spinning up clones is cheap, but aged anchors are scarce timber that takes years to grow. A fresh farm starts out on bare tundra with token payouts, while real agents carry the pigment of time that no script can paint on overnight.
